latestVersion.changelog:
Video Audio Replace Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly replace audio tracks in video files up to 2 minutes, with simple text instructions and fast 1080p downloads.
- Automatic handling of session, authentication, and credits; supports both registered and anonymous users.
- Accepts common video (mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv) and audio (mp3, wav, m4a, aac) formats up to 500MB.
- Clean, streamlined interface — no timeline editing, export settings, or complex workflows required.
- Real-time session updates and clear feedback on upload, state, export, credits, or errors.
